introduction: My career connects finance and technology: systematic fund operations at Man Group, commodity pricing at Louis Dreyfus Company, and hands-on development and application support across several industries.
evidence: I trace financial numbers back to their source, investigate data breaks and explain the findings to finance and technology colleagues. Alongside my finance roles, I build and run Neutron.bg, a live Django e-commerce platform.

highlights.text: Systematic trading fund experience at Man Group
Senior Pricing Middle Officer at Louis Dreyfus Company
Master's in E-Management, graduated with Honours
